title: Why I Don't Use The KwikPen
hook: Here's why I stopped using the pen to inject Zepbound and use a needle and vial instead.
body:
The problem with the pen is that it's more difficult to get a dose outside standard doses. With a vial and a needle, adjusting your dose precisely is much easier. And once you get good with a needle, it is less painful than the pen. The pen fires the drug at its own speed. You control the needle. You get a vial and insulin syringes, the tiny ones, and your dose is measured in units on the side of the barrel. Your doctor or pharmacy will tell you how many units equals a milligram for the concentration you have. Then you just pull back to that line. If you can read a measuring cup, you can do this.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor.
close: Comment below to let me know if you're using the pen or a needle and vial.
